text: dsh-genui 是面向 DSH 网页端的生成式界面插件。它接入系统提示词和对话回复渲染，将 schemaJson 解析为可操作的 Vue 卡片，并把普通 Markdown 与卡片混合展示。用户可生成图表、表单、表格和小应用，提交表单或点击操作后把状态带回对话。输入框菜单可切换提示词档位，选择会保存在 DSH 设置中；使用 DSH web profile 安装即可。

dsh-genui adds interactive UI to DSH web replies. It parses schemaJson into Vue cards mixed with Markdown. Users can create charts, forms, tables, and mini apps; card actions and form state continue the conversation. A composer menu selects and saves the authoring prompt tier.
我想让 AI 把数据直接画成图表，而不是只给我一段文字。
能不能在聊天回答里生成一张可以填写并提交的表单？
我想把助手输出的 schemaJson 卡片直接渲染成网页组件。
让对话里的按钮选择和表单内容自动带到下一轮消息里。
我希望模型按需要输出图表或表单，普通问题继续用文字回答。
怎么在 DSH 输入框里切换界面生成提示词的详细程度？
I want charts and interactive forms to appear inside assistant replies.
Can users submit a card and send its state back into the conversation?
I need the chat renderer to support both schemaJson fences and XML-style schema tags.
How can I choose whether the model gets compact or full UI authoring guidance?
dsh-genui 的功能「回复卡片渲染」：把回答中的 schemaJson 代码围栏或 XML 标签解析为卡片，并与 Markdown 混排；流式生成时也处理尚未闭合的卡片内容。
dsh-genui 的功能「卡片交互回传」：卡片按钮可触发 continueChat 操作，提交短消息并把卡片状态序列化后放入 DSH 草稿，再提交为下一轮对话。
dsh-genui 的功能「提示词档位切换」：在输入框工具栏菜单选择 Off、Mini、Standard 或 Plus，切换模型收到的界面生成指南，并通过 DSH 设置保存选择。
dsh-genui 的功能「图文回复混排」：保留普通 Markdown 文本，同时把 schemaJson 内容作为独立卡片渲染，让同一条回复可以同时呈现说明和可交互组件。
dsh-genui 使用前须知：将提示词档位设为 Off 会移除模型的 GenUI 生成提示，但浏览器侧的卡片渲染仍然启用。

> Turn [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) replies from a wall of text into an interface you can actually click.

You ask the AI to run a calculation and get back a formula. You ask it to file a request and get eight Markdown bullets. You ask about last week's traffic and get numbers lined up as plain text.

dsh-genui README · dsh-genui：Nothing is wrong — but you still do the work yourself: copy, paste, do the math in your head, then type another message saying "I'll take the second one."

**dsh-genui** is a plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Install it, ask the same questions, and the answer grows a real interface: calculator keys you can press, dropdowns you can pick from, charts with actual axes. Whatever you click or fill in flows back into the conversation, and the AI picks up from there.

- `pnpm` installed (DSH uses it to manage plugins). If you don't have it, run `corepack enable` or `npm i -g pnpm`, then **open a new terminal** and check that `pnpm -v` prints a version

text:
dsh-genui README · Option 2: run it yourself：In a new terminal:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-genui
```

This pulls from the public npm registry — no npm account, no cloning the repo.

dsh-genui README · Restart afterwards (don't skip this)：DSH locks in its plugin set at startup, so **nothing changes in the UI until you restart**.

1. Go back to the terminal running DSH and press `Ctrl+C`
2. Start it again: `dsh web`
3. Refresh the browser
4. **Start a new conversation**

dsh-genui README · GenUI authoring prompt：GenUI authoring starts on 标准 and remembers your last choice across DSH restarts. The sparkle menu in the composer tool row follows DSH's language. In Chinese the tiers are 关闭, 精简, 标准, and 全量; in every other language they are Off, Mini, Standard, and Plus. Off sends no GenUI prompt. Mini is forms, tables, and cards. Standard adds tabs and charts. Plus adds trees, dialogs, and the rest of the component set. Hover an item to read what it includes. Card rendering stays installed either way.

dsh-genui README · Check that it worked：In the new conversation, say:

> Generate a calculator

If a working calculator appears in the reply, you're set. If you only see a code block, the plugin isn't active — see the FAQ below.

To verify before restarting:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

You should see a `dsh-genui` layer in the output.

dsh-genui README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-genui
```

This also requires a restart to take effect.

dsh-genui README · FAQ：**Still showing a code block after installing?**

Nine times out of ten you skipped the restart or you're still in an old session. Run through all four steps: stop, restart, refresh, new conversation.

**Why do I see raw `<schemaJson>` tags or backticks instead of a rendered card?**

GenUI accepts two formats for the schema block:

- ````schemaJson … ```` (backtick fence — GenUI-native format)
- `<schemaJson> … </schemaJson>` (XML-style tags — DSH boot-context format)

dsh-genui README · FAQ：Both are rendered identically if the model uses either one. If you see *neither* format rendered and the raw code is visible, the plugin isn't active yet — follow the restart steps above.

**`pnpm not found on PATH`?**

DSH needs pnpm to manage plugins. Run `corepack enable` (or `npm i -g pnpm`), then **open a new terminal** — PATH won't update in the old one.

**The AI doesn't use interfaces on its own?**

dsh-genui README · FAQ：If the sparkle menu is 关闭, the model has no GenUI authoring guidance. Pick 精简, 标准, or 全量, then say something like "give me a form / chart / interface." Charts need 标准 or 全量.

**Does this change how DSH normally works?**

No. Questions that don't need an interface get regular text answers, exactly as before.

**Does it uninstall cleanly?**

Yes. Run `dsh plugin remove`, restart, and DSH is back to its original state with no leftover config.

---
dsh-genui README · How it works：In short: the model no longer writes only text — it also writes a *description of an interface*, and the browser renders that description into real components.

dsh-genui README · How it works：A bit more detail: the plugin adds a prompt section teaching the model to emit structured JSON (inside a `schemaJson` code block) when an interface would help. The composer sparkle menu picks that section's size and starts on 标准. The DSH web client picks up the JSON and hands it to a renderer. It's streaming, so the interface appears as the model writes it — no waiting for the full reply.

dsh-genui README · How it works：The components come from [OpenTiny GenUI SDK](https://opentiny.design/genui-sdk) and the OpenTiny Vue library — OpenTiny's generative-UI stack, a spec plus rendering engine for letting LLMs produce interfaces. dsh-genui wires that into the DSH conversation flow.

On safety: the model can only use whitelisted components. It cannot inject HTML or scripts, so nothing strange ends up in your conversation.

text: dsh-genui README · GenUI 提示词：GenUI 提示词默认是「标准」，并且会记住你上一次的选择。输入框工具行里的星形菜单可以选关闭、精简、标准、全量（界面语言不是中文时显示为 Off、Mini、Standard、Plus），悬停可看每一档的说明。关闭时不注入提示词。精简覆盖表单、表格和卡片；标准再加标签页和图表；全量再加树、弹窗等其余组件。它只控制发给模型的提示词，卡片渲染能力始终保留。

> 生成一个计算器

dsh --profile web --dump-config

dsh-genui README · 常见问题：**装完还是显示成代码块？**

九成是没重启，或者还在用旧会话。按上面「装完必须重启」的四步走一遍：停服务 → 重启 → 刷新浏览器 → 开新会话。

**提示 `pnpm not found on PATH`？**

DSH 管理插件依赖 pnpm。执行 `corepack enable`（或 `npm i -g pnpm`）之后，**新开一个终端**再试，因为 PATH 在旧终端里不会更新。

**AI 不主动用界面回答？**

如果星形菜单是「关闭」，模型不会收到 GenUI 提示词。改成精简、标准或全量，再说一句「用界面/表单/图表的方式给我」就行。图表需要标准或全量。

**会不会影响原来的用法？**

不会。不需要界面的问题，AI 照常用文字回答，和以前一模一样。

**卸载干净吗？**

`dsh plugin remove` 之后重启，DSH 完全恢复原样，不留残留配置。

dsh-genui README · 它是怎么做到的：一句话：AI 不再只写文字，它还会写一段「界面描述」，浏览器把这段描述渲染成真正的组件。

具体一点：插件默认给模型加一段提示词，教它在需要的时候输出一段结构化的 JSON（写在 `schemaJson` 代码块里）；输入框里的星形菜单选择这段提示词的档位，默认是「标准」。DSH 网页端拿到 JSON 后，交给渲染器变成实际组件。整个过程是流式的，AI 写到哪、界面就渲染到哪，不用等它把话说完。

组件本身来自 [OpenTiny GenUI SDK](https://opentiny.design/genui-sdk) 和 OpenTiny Vue 组件库——这是 OpenTiny 团队做的生成式 UI 方案，一整套「让大模型输出界面」的规范和渲染引擎。dsh-genui 做的事情，是把它接到了 DSH 的对话流里。

顺带说一句安全：模型能用的组件是白名单里的那些，它塞不进 HTML 或脚本，所以不用担心对话里跑出奇怪的东西。
